reviewed_by: Codex harness chat single-active-turn incident review
reason: A second harness send to one active conversation must return a conflict before it forks a vendor session or saves a second message. The selected Python test covers direct runtime and HTTP admission, durable turn and message counts, pending-turn reads, and recovery after the first turn stops. The selected real-Core browser journey checks that a running harness chat reconnects and reloads across desktop and mobile profiles.
exclusions: No UI or native source changed, so no frontend unit or native tests are selected. Unrelated Python files and browser journeys are excluded. Physical mobile devices are unavailable; the selected browser profiles are emulated. The live production Core is left running for active research and is not redeployed in this branch task.
